_readme: Every photo on the site. `src` is a URL (downloaded once into .cache/) or a path under originals/. `focal` is the CSS object-position used when a photo is cropped. `crop` trims the source first as [left, top, right, bottom] fractions. `hero` photos get a 2400px size. Run `npm run images` after editing. `plate` stores the photo in greyscale, for hero plates (the stylesheet prints them in two inks).
